The '''consul''' of the [[Ishanna system/Legends|Ishanna system]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual. He stubbornly refused to open the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] mineral deposits to mining, but outside factions turned the system's representatives against the consul and forced him to reverse the decision.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Whatever It Takes}}</ref>
